# 第三方资源

- [Kenney Building Kit 1.0](https://kenney.nl/assets/building-kit)：门、门洞和纹理；[CC0 声明](kenney-building/License.txt)。
- [Kenney Furniture Kit 2.0](https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit)：家具模型；[CC0 声明](kenney-furniture/License.txt)。
- [ch-bas/threejs-sims-house-builder](https://github.com/ch-bas/threejs-sims-house-builder/tree/94922dcdf28de07e7d2a538cca09a887f7afcd94)：墙面法向判断的剖切思路；保留 [MIT 声明](ch-bas/LICENSE)。

运行时资源位于 `frontend/public/assets/`；原模型文件的校验值见 [asset-sha256.json](asset-sha256.json)。Python 和 JavaScript 依赖由安装命令从各自的包仓库取得，许可见依赖包。
